verdict.rationale: Notion markets 'agents' that 'keep work moving 24/7' and offers webhooks/APIs that could underpin background automations, but the evidence pack lacks concrete documentation of a scheduling/automation builder or details on how these agents run autonomously without user intervention. missing for 10: detailed docs on the Notion Automations feature (triggers, scheduling, conditions), independent hands-on confirmation that agents run unattended, and clarity on reliability/limits of background execution.
